invariants.name: text_table_live_entities_bounded
invariants.note: Issue #8 §3.4/§3.5 forbids one retained entity per logical cell. Bound is the catalog-8 geometric window: uniform_window_item_cap = ceil((viewport + 2×overscan)/extent)+2 → 58 rows × 22 cols → live = rows + rows×cols = 1334, not rows×columns. Missing live_ui_entities stays not-evaluable.
